queries.sql: SELECT `nt`.`id`, `nt`.`numero`, `op`.`nom` as `operateur`, `s`.`montant` as `solde_actuel`, `s`.`date` as `date_solde` FROM `numero_telephone` `nt` JOIN `prefixe_operateur` `po` ON `po`.`id` = `nt`.`id_prefixe` JOIN `operateur` `op` ON `op`.`id` = `po`.`id_operateur` LEFT JOIN `solde` `s` ON `s`.`id` = (SELECT id FROM solde WHERE id_numero_tel = nt.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY `nt`.`id` ASC
